function_schema.name: get_zodiac_compatibility
function_schema.description: Retrieve the compatibility score between two Zodiac signs.

scale.description: The scale on which compatibility should be shown. Default is 'percentage'.

function_schema.name: local_nursery.find
function_schema.description: Locate local nurseries based on location and plant types availability.

location.description: The city or locality where the nursery needs to be located.

plant_types.description: Type of plants the nursery should provide.

function_schema.name: get_sculpture_info
function_schema.description: Retrieves the most recent artwork by a specified artist with its detailed description.

year.description: Year of the sculpture. This is optional. Default 2000

detail.description: If True, it provides detailed description of the sculpture. Defaults to False.

function_schema.name: monarch.getMonarchOfYear
function_schema.description: Retrieve the monarch of a specific location during a specified year.

location.description: The location (e.g., country) whose monarch needs to be found.

year.description: The year to search the monarch.

fullName.description: If true, returns the full name and title of the monarch.
